nodes.title: Rejected: offering the Operator model every tool the member's role may use on every call.
nodes.tried: operator/loop.ts sent all role-allowed tools (plus operator_plan with every name in its enum) on each model call.
nodes.broke: On the real modules an owner's request carried 166 tools and 80,361 schema chars (~23k tokens), so the 60k-token turn cap allowed about 2 model calls; above the 128 tools some OpenAI-style endpoints are reported to cap at (unverified). Measured by tests/operator-toolset.test.ts with the old loop: n=5 requests, every one 166 tools; the size guard fails with 'a request offered 166 tools (cap 40)'.

nodes.title: The Operator offers at most 40 tools per model call: the page's tools (client sends page), tools the message's words point at, tools used earlier in the thread, a core read set, operator_plan, and operator_find_tools to pull more into the next call of the same turn. Offering is not permission: the role filter and SCREEN_ONLY are unchanged. Turn caps: 8 model calls (was 6), 60k tokens.
nodes.reverse_if: A real model fails tasks because a needed tool was not offered and it did not call operator_find_tools, more often than a measured threshold; or providers make large tool lists cheap and unlimited.

nodes.title: Operator tool payload per model call, owner role, real modules, scripted model: before 166 tools / 80,361 schema chars (n=5); after, agents page 29 tools / 14,489 chars (n=5), campaigns page with one find_tools lookup 33-40 tools / 18,169-22,421 chars, mean 20,295 (n=6). About 72-82% smaller.
nodes.method: JSON length of the tools array in each recorded LlmRequest, tests/operator-toolset.test.ts, before = the same test against the previous loop.ts

nodes.title: A calls monitor issue triggers learning.propose automatically (job learning.propose_from_issues): content signals only (early hang-ups, opt-outs, safety interventions), the agent its evidence calls ran, one run and at most one proposal per issue, at most 3 runs per workspace per IST day. Proposals are drafts; probe, accept (A2) and start (A2) still gate any live traffic.
nodes.rationale: Owner wants learning to start itself; the blueprint's triage puts engineering causes (tool failures, engine errors, dropped quotes) before content, so those never become script proposals.
nodes.reverse_if: Auto-drafted proposals are mostly rejected by owners (noise), or engineering-signal issues turn out to have content causes often enough to propose on them.

nodes.title: Operator tool results longer than resultChars (8,000) reach the model cut mid-JSON (seen with agent.create, whose result carries the whole draft). A real model may misread or miss ids at the end.
nodes.closes_when: Large tool results are summarised to their ids and key fields (or the clip keeps valid JSON) and a test shows the model still gets every id it needs.

events.details: Operator offers at most 40 tools per call plus operator_find_tools (payload 80k -> 14-22k chars); learning drafts one proposal per content monitor issue (3/day). Fresh-DB suite 388/389 (1 voice-runtime skip), browser flows 22/22, ui-contract strict clean.
